title: fix(driver-mongodb): index a single-valued master_detail field at schema sync
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9G1TFbzqhGsqfJSFCwumpt4)_

Fixes #31900

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：MongoDB 驱动在 schema 同步时给单值主从字段(master_detail)建一个普通索引 `idx_字段名`;查找和用户字段的索引原样不动。
- 为什么改：子对象按父记录读(controlled_by_parent 的权限过滤每次都这样读)在 MongoDB 上没有索引可用，会扫描整个集合;SQL 驱动的同一缺口由 #31882 处理。
- 风险与回滚：只多建一个非唯一索引，读写结果不变;已有部署下次启动同步时补建。回滚即撤销本 PR,已建的索引留着无害，也可手动删。
- 先看：`packages/drivers/driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-schema.ts` 新增的 master_detail 分支和 `leadingDeclared` 集合;再看同目录测试文件末尾的新 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-mongodb exec vitest run src/mongodb-schema-declared-indexes.test.ts`,预期 14 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`syncCollectionSchema` (driver-mongodb) now pushes one plain index op for every field that is `type: 'master_detail'`, has a truthy `reference`, and is not `multiple`:

- key `{ FIELD: 1 }`, options `{ name: 'idx_FIELD' }` (non-unique);
- skipped when a declaration already leads with the field: any declared `indexes[]` entry whose first usable field is FIELD (unique ones included, because `nullDistinctUniqueOps` pairs each unique with a plain read index over the same keys), or a field-level `unique` on FIELD (same pairing);
- the `lookup` (with `reference`) / `user` arm is not touched: same predicate, same `idx_FIELD_lookup` name, same position in the op list.

Existing deployments get the index on the next schema sync (every boot unless `OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC=1` / `skipSchemaSync`). `createIndex` with the same name, key and options is a no-op, so the sync after that does nothing.

Name: `idx_FIELD` is what a declared `{ fields: [FIELD] }` produces in this driver, so an author who declares that index later converges on the same index. This follows the seat's naming answer for driver-sql (#31882, seat answer 6738355121, item 2). The alternative, `idx_FIELD_lookup` like the lookup arm, is listed under open questions in the report.

No tenant key part: this driver refuses tenant-scoped objects (`mongodb-tenancy-guard.ts`), so the by-parent read is `find({ FIELD: id })` and a single-key index serves it.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in the existing shared harness `src/mongodb-schema-declared-indexes.test.ts` (7 cases), driven against a fake `Db` that keeps the collection's index set the way mongod does for the three rules the create loop meets (same name and spec is a no-op; same name, different spec is refused 86; another name over the same key is refused 85):

1. a single-valued master_detail gets `idx_project` `{ project: 1 }`, non-unique; CONTROL: `idx_task_lookup` / `idx_member_lookup` byte-identical, exact op list;
2. multi-valued, reference-less and blank-reference master_detail get nothing;
3. a declared index leading with the field (single, compound, author-named, unique compound) adds no second index; CONTROL: the asked op list equals the one the same declaration produces when the field is `text`;
4. a declared index with the field in a later position does not count as covering;
5. a master_detail that is also field-level `unique` keeps the one `idx_account` read index;
6. an existing deployment (seeded with what main builds) gains exactly `idx_project`, and a second sync builds nothing; CONTROL: lookup/user keys still carry only their main-built index;
7. an author who declares `{ fields: ['project'] }` later gets no second index.

No existing test was changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **`explain` was not measured against a real mongod.** The real-server suites here are opt-in (#5517), `fastdl.mongodb.org` answers 403 in the card container, and running a conda-forge mongod binary was refused by the container's permission layer. Per the card's delta, the pins use the driver's existing fake-`Db` test double instead. The planner claim (an equality on a single-key index is an index scan) is the documented MongoDB behaviour, not a reading from this PR.
- Write cost on MongoDB is not measured; the changeset says so. #31882 measured +3% PG / +6% SQLite on a 20k bulk insert for one master_detail index on driver-sql.
- An author who later declares a COMPOUND index leading with the field stops asking for `idx_FIELD`, but the index already built stays: this driver has no orphan-drop pass (driver-sql's plan does). It is harmless redundancy; noted, not filed.
- The `lookup`/`user` arm still has no "already declared" skip and still indexes `multiple: true` lookups. Unchanged on purpose (card: existing behaviour stays).
- Driver conformance ledger: 66 covered · 6 DEBT · 0 exempt before and after (`node scripts/check-driver-conformance.mjs`); no case set covers schema indexes, so no row moves.

## Verification

Head `06664692`, base `a15b544d`.

<details><summary>Step 0 on main: the new pins against main's source</summary>

With only the test commit applied (`68b588cb`), `vitest run src/mongodb-schema-declared-indexes.test.ts`: 4 failed | 10 passed (14). Red: the single-valued case (`expected undefined to be defined` for `idx_project`), the later-position case, the existing-deployment case, the author-declares-later case. The skip/dedupe/unique cases are green on main because main builds nothing for master_detail; their teeth are shown by the ablations below.

Code path on main: `mongodb-schema.ts` selects `(field.type === 'lookup' && field.reference) || field.type === 'user'`; `master_detail` matches neither disjunct, so the field gets no index. Declared names: `idx.name` or `idx_FIELDS[_unique]`; implicit lookup name `idx_FIELD_lookup`.
</details>

<details><summary>Package tests, typecheck, lint</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-mongodb test`: Test Files 36 passed | 6 skipped (42), Tests 746 passed | 198 skipped (944). The 6 skipped files are the opt-in real-mongod suites.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-mongodb typecheck` (incl. `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/drivers/driver-mongodb/src` (the package has no `lint` script): exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; tests import src directly, so no dist leg)</summary>

| Leg | Mutation | Result | Restore |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | master_detail predicate off (`'master_detail'` → `'master_detail_ABLATED'`) | 3 failed: single-valued, later-position, existing-deployment | blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty |
| B | declared-leading skip off (`has(fieldName)` → `has('ABLATED')`) | 2 failed: declared-leading, field-level unique | same |
| C | multi-valued skip off | 1 failed: multi-valued / no-parent | same |
| D | name `idx_FIELD` → `idx_FIELD_md_ablated` | 4 failed, incl. author-declares-later (`expected [ 'idx_project_md_ablated' ] to deeply equal [ 'idx_project' ]`) | same |

C's first attempt used a replacement that already occurred in the file; the tool refused it before running and restored the file. The second attempt used a unique replacement.
</details>
